test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3
solution:
The correct answer is '**practised**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses traditional medicines that have been used for a long time and are still being used.
 
• The appropriate word should be in the past participle form to indicate the continuous usage over a long period.
 
• "**Practised**" fits well as it correctly describes how the traditional medicines have been used all over the world for centuries.
 
• Other options ("**practice**", "**practises**", "**practices**") do not fit correctly in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Traditional medicines (TMs) make (1) use of__ natural products and are of great importance. Such forms of medicine as traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), Ayurveda, Kampo, traditional Korean medicine (TKM), and Unani (2) __employ__ natural products and have been (3) __practiced__ all over the world for hundreds or even thousands of years, and they (4) _______ blossomed into orderly-regulated systems of medicine. In their various forms, they may have certain defects, but they (5) _______ still a valuable repository of human knowledge.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Practice: "Practice" is a noun and does not fit the verb requirement in this context.
 
• Practises(British English): "Practises" is in the present tense and does not indicate the historical continuity of usage.
 
• Practices (American English): "Practices" is in the present tense and does not convey the extended duration of usage.
